title: A Systematic Analysis of Automatic Differentiation versus Discretization-based Constraints for Physics-Informed PDE Solvers
abstract: arXiv:2609.07437v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) represent a growing frontier in using artificial intelligence to solve partial differential equations (PDEs). Automatic differentiation (AD) plays a central role in this paradigm, which is mesh-free and replaces traditional iterative solvers with gradient-based optimization in continuous space. However, the inherent limitations of AD, particularly in handling higher-order derivatives and discontinuous solutions, pose significant challenges for complex problems. This has motivated a growing number of researchers to explore discretization-based constraints as an alternative path. Yet, the respective applicability of these two paradigms remains largely unexplored. In this work, we conduct systematic experiments across a wide spectrum of problems, from simple linear Poisson to high-Mach hypersonic flows with strong discontinuities. translated_title: 物理信息偏微分方程求解器中自动微分与基于离散化约束的系统性分析
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）代表了利用人工智能求解偏微分方程（PDEs）的一个新兴前沿领域。自动微分（AD）在这一范式中扮演着核心角色，它无需网格，用连续空间中基于梯度的优化取代了传统的迭代求解器。然而，自动微分的固有局限性，特别是在处理高阶导数和不连续解方面，给复杂问题带来了重大挑战。这促使越来越多的研究者探索基于离散化的约束作为替代路径。然而，这两种范式各自的适用性在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们在广泛的问题范围内进行了系统性实验，涵盖从简单的线性泊松方程到具有强不连续性的高马赫数高超音速流动。通过对近似、优化等环节的严格分解……
tldr: 该论文通过从简单线性泊松方程到强不连续高超音速流动的广泛系统性实验，首次系统分析了物理信息PDE求解器中自动微分与基于离散化约束两种范式的各自适用性。
